# 2 Baruch Chapter 52 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 52:3 — fate of the wicked

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Those-who-are-in-darkness will-pass-away" |
| LOGOS | "Those who are in darkness will pass away" |
| PNEUMA | "Those who are in darkness will vanish away" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Pass away' (Syriac: ne'brun) has the sense of ceasing to exist or departing; PNEUMA's 'vanish' introduces a slightly different nuance of disappearance.

---

## 52:4 — state of the righteous

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-will-return and-not-be-disquieted" |
| LOGOS | "they will return and not be disquieted" |
| PNEUMA | "they will return without anxiety" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Disquieted' preserves the Syriac met'addar (troubled/distressed) more precisely than PNEUMA's 'without anxiety'.

---

## 52:8 — law and deeds as witnesses

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "a-law will-be-judgment-upon-them, and-a-deed will-stand-as-a-witness" |
| LOGOS | "a law will be judgment upon them, and a deed will stand as a witness" |
| PNEUMA | "The law will be their judgment, and their deeds will testify against them" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac has singular 'a deed' (not plural 'deeds'), which LOGOS preserves and PNEUMA pluralizes incorrectly.

---
